supporting_pages.title: "Analyze database fleet health using Gemini \_|\_ Database Center \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: You can use Database Center to learn more about your database fleet health by prompting Gemini to answer questions about the following: Database fleet inventory information Database fleet health Database configuration best practices The following are example prompts to help you learn about your database fleet inventory data: "How many PostgreSQL instances do I have in Tokyo?" "How many of my database resources are not NIST 800-53 compliant?" "Why is it an issue that my database is exposed to ownership chaining?" "Why is it an issue that my database is not logging only DDL statements?" Note: Gemini provides query suggestions and health issues based on all instances and databases in your project.
